Chapter 6506: Sin

Chapter 6506: Sin

North Kun God and Tenacious never dared to imagine this potential. This level of temporal manipulation exceeded their comprehension.

Moreover, a regular immortal couldn’t have done this. It exerted total domination over the fate of all beings.

They had never seen anything like this before. Desolate Ancestor and Zhan Sansheng couldn’t have done so.

“Goddamn, this is the high heaven and its domain, everyone should just give up.” The skull mumbled.

Left and Right Splendor experienced the temporal reversal and exchanged glances of shock.

“What do you think?” Left asked.

“I don’t know.” Right stared at him in confusion.

“Compared to those old men?” Left finally understood Li Qiye’s true power.

“What can they do?” Right said.

“Only the villainous heaven?” Left asked.

“Who knows, we never saw it before.” Right responded.

“What about the octopus?” Left asked.

“Would be roasted, so delicious.” Right said.

“I wanna eat some roasted octopus.” Left became distracted.

Meanwhile, the timeline returned to when the flame was still inside the tube. Once it flowed again, Li Qiye appeared before and grasped the outcoming flame with a primordial light.

He kneaded it into a pill and tossed it into his mouth, chewing as if it were a delicacy before swallowing.

This scene shocked all the powerful cultivators. The flame of a true immortal capable of eradicating Old World was eaten like a snack.

He smacked his lips, as if savoring the taste.

“Yeah, he’s the villainous heaven.” Left and Right exchanged glances.

“Villainous heaven is a bastard, so he’s a bastard too?” Right said.

“No different, those who reach this level are all unpredictable bastards.” Left agreed.

“Damn, it’s over, doesn’t matter that we were born in the primordial. This world is theirs now, the three bastards.” In another location, the skull shared the same sentiment.

As for Seventy-two, he became frozen. He understood the power of the flame and used it to destroy the whole world.

When Poye gave it to him, Poye also warned him of its destructive nature. However, it was kneaded into a pill and eaten by Li Qiye.

The opponent’s height exceeded everyone’s imagination and sense of logic. Only a dream could explain this.

“Not only are you a fool, you also deserve death.” Li Qiye said.

Seventy-two didn’t react and only stared blankly at Li Qiye. The guy was more frightening than a ghost and left him shocked.

Li Qiye reached forward and crushed the supreme vessel made from two major realms. It seemed fragile like a porcelain doll, exposing Seventy-two.

“What do you want?!” He shouted after being captured.

“Death is not enough, and there is no atonement for what you tried to do. You shall be damned for eternity.” Li Qiye said before removing the vitality, life force, worldly energy, and dao power that had been taken from the three sects.

“Ahhh!” The process made him bellow in agony, no different from flying his skin and ripping his tendons piece by piece.

However, the echoing cries earned him no sympathy from spectators.

Once fully extracted, Li Qiye sent the essences back to the three sects. The land healed with growing trees and vegetation. Life would return in time.

“Eternal damnation.” Li Qiye said before sealing Seventy-two into the ground.

While trapped by dirt and soil, his body broke apart and out came countless tendrils. He became a part of the land; his vitality and dao power nourished it. The physical torment was excruciating but he couldn’t die.
